# For counters: the quick guide {#sec-counters-quick-guide}

```{r}
#| include: false
source(here::here("_common.R"))
```

::: {.audience}
For counters
:::

Two pages to keep by the counter. Print this page from your browser, or keep
it open on the phone. The full steps are in @sec-a-count and @sec-boxes.

## Before you start

- **You count blind.** Nothing on the counting screen shows how many there
  should be. Count what's in front of you, not what you expect.
- **Every tap is saved.** If the phone rings or the app closes, your count is
  still there.
- **No swipe changes a count by itself.** A swipe only shows a button; you
  still tap it.

## Start or join a count

1. Open the **Count** tab. Tap a count under **In progress**, or **Start a
   count** for a new one (location, what to count, then **Start**).
2. If the app asks **Who's counting?**, choose your name and enter your PIN.
   You stay signed in while the count is open, through 15 minutes away.

## Count each product

- **+** adds one, for each piece, pair or set you pick up. **−** takes one
  away. A dash (–) means not counted yet.
- **Tap the number** to type a count: **Add** adds to what you have so far
  (tray by tray), **Set total** replaces it.
- **Earrings are counted in pairs.** An earring with no mate goes under
  **Singles** on the same sheet, never as a pair.
- **Swipe right, then tap None here**, when you've looked and there are none.
  That counts 0, which isn't the same as leaving it uncounted.
- **Swipe left, then tap Clear**, to start a product again.
- **Undo** shows for a few seconds after a change of more than one, and after
  every Clear. It puts the count back exactly as it was.

## Find a product

- Type in **Find a product**: a name, SKU or barcode.
- The **⋯** menu's **Show** lists only the products **Not counted**, to check
  nothing was missed.
- **Find by code** (the barcode button) finds a product from its label. It
  never counts it: you still tap +.

## A box or tray at once

- **Scan tags** reads the piece tags on a tray. **Box photo** counts a box of
  pieces on cards from a photo.
- Nothing counts until you check the box and tap **Add**. Box photos aren't
  yet measured on real shop boxes, so check every piece.
- Pieces with no design yet go to **To identify** on the counting screen. Tap
  it and pick each one from the list.

## When you're done

- Tap **Submit**. Counting stops and the count waits for an approver who
  didn't count in it.
- If more needs counting after you submit, ask an approver to **Reopen for
  counting**.
- If the owner counts alone, without People set up, there's no Submit: the
  owner taps **Review** instead (@sec-solo-path).

## Counting questions

**Why can't I see how many there should be?**
So the number can't sway your count. The approver sees it in Review.

**I counted the wrong product.**
Tap − or Undo, or swipe left and tap Clear, then count it again.

**A product isn't in the list.**
It may be a type this count doesn't cover, or archived. Tell the owner;
don't count it under another product.

**The app asked for my PIN again.**
You were away for more than 15 minutes, or left the count. Your figures are
all still there.

**I found one earring on its own.**
Add it under **Singles**. It's flagged for the owner and never changes the
pairs.
